Name: Shaaph, Son of Maachah
Summary: Son of Caleb's concubine Maachah, called the father of Madmannah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:49: Son of Caleb's concubine Maachah, called the father of Madmannah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shaaph stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
